blindSummary: Regional record: this state/province has a bohemian port-university culture; criminality is general rather than gender-targeted. In 2024 it concentrated 51.32% of all national recorded anti-LGBTI discrimination cases (the second-ranked state/province at 25.12%), up 80.93% over 2023. In 2025 recorded cases fell here alongside the second-ranked state/province while all other regions rose; a national LGBT-rights organisation attributes the fall to a decentralisation of hostility toward territories with less LGBTIQ visibility and debate.
blindSourceSummaries: An international LGBT-rights organisation's country overview for this country (updated March 2026): same-sex marriage and adoption since March 2022; hate-crime law covering SOGI since 2012; self-determination legal gender recognition since 2019; first lesbophobic-femicide conviction in 2025 under a femicide statute provision; national pushback - a parliamentary commission approved in May 2025 portrays gender-affirming care as a threat to children and recommends banning minor hormones; a national gender-identity transition-care programme was excluded from the 2026 budget; a right-wing candidate's 2025 presidential election success was flagged by civil society. National-level context.

A foreign LGBT news outlet (March 19, 2025) describes 2024 as a year of regression for LGBTQ rights in this country - national framing: a parliamentary commission on trans youth inspired by a contested external evidence review, and the broader 2024-2025 backlash trends.

A national LGBT-rights organisation's annual human-rights report on sexual and gender diversity in this country (published March 2026, covering 2025): this state/province concentrated 51.32% of national recorded anti-LGBTI discrimination cases in 2024, up 80.93% over 2023; in 2025 cases fell only in this state/province and the second-ranked state/province while all other regions rose - the organisation attributes this to a decentralisation of hate toward territories where LGBTIQ themes have less visibility; full per-region and per-commune series 2002-2025.
blindTangential: National-level hostility climate reaching the region: a parliamentary commission approved a report in May 2025 framing gender-affirming care for youth as harmful (recommending hormone bans for minors), giving political weight to stigmatising narratives that shape public hostility a visitor may encounter.
